label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
**Dumper – have a read before I bend your ear in the van**

Lee,

We've been doing the bigger jobs together fifteen years now, so I'll keep this short and put it in writing rather than go on at you.

**What the hire's costing us**

We had the tracked dumper off Sittingbourne 14 days this year. £85 a day, plus £30 delivery every time, came to roughly £1,600 all in. That's money out the door every time and nothing to show for it at the end.

**What's for sale**

Bloke in Faversham's got a 2019 500kg tracked one up at £1,650 ono. Says new tracks went on last spring. Halves is £825 each. It'd live in my lean-to at the yard, under cover, so no extra cost there.

**Why I reckon it stacks up**

- We've already got three patio digs and the Boughton drive booked for spring.
- In September the hire place didn't have one, so we barrowed six ton of muck at Hernhill by hand. Two extra days, and your back was shot for a week.
- Delivery driver turned up at 11 once and we lost half the morning standing about.
- At this year's use it pays for itself in about a year. At half that use, about two years. That's before servicing and repairs.
- If it doesn't work out we sell it on. These hold their value.

**Running it**

Servicing 50/50, and whoever breaks it pays for it. Simple as that, no arguments.

**Saturday**

Come and have a look with me before someone else has it. I'll pick you up at 9 if that suits.
